name: docs-loop-pr-aggregation
description: A one-plugin marketplace for the DIAL docs plugin that collects the open [DIAL Loop] pull requests of epam/ai-dial into one aggregation pull request.

plugins.name: docs-loop-pr-aggregation
plugins.description: Merge every open [DIAL Loop] pull request into one aggregation pull request against development, resolve the conflicts, and close the source pull requests with a link to it.
